import re
text = """
Before everyone heads out, a quick reminder: the midterm is next week. Be familiar with the differential equations on page 245. Problems 32, 33, and 44 from that page are likely candidates. Also, brush up on the last page of the integration section — page 197. I expect problem 22 from page 197 to appear on your midterm. And don’t forget the section on related rates on pages 132, 133, and 134.
"""
nums = sorted(set(int(n) for n in re.findall(r"\d+", text)))
print(",".join(str(n) for n in nums))
